question:
Find out the correct synonym of the following word:

Obvious
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** The word "**obvious"** means something that is easily **perceived **or **understood, clear, self-evident, or apparent**.

 
 
• it was** obvious** a storm was about to come.
 
 
 
• Among the options provided, "**clear" **is the** synonym** that best** fits this definition.**

Hence the synonym for **'obvious'** is** 'clear**'​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Why the other options are incorrect:**

 
 
• **Dubious:** This word means hesitating or doubting, which is the opposite of being obvious or clear.

 
 
• I was rather **dubious** about the whole idea
 
 
 
• **Ambiguous:** This word means open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning, which is contrary to the meaning of obvious.
 
 
• it was an **ambiguous** sentence that could be taken in two ways
 
 
 
• **Doubtful:** Similar to dubious, this means feeling uncertain about something, which is not a synonym for obvious.
 
 
• he looked** doubtful**, but gave a nod.
